title: Retrieval, Storage & Caching
description: Study data ingestion and index freshness, tenant isolation and access filters, cache invalidation and correctness, and consistency and index migration. Each lesson includes a worked example and an applied practice task.

lessons.title: Data ingestion and index freshness
lessons.description: Define version metadata and a freshness alert.
lessons.conceptOverview: Separate ingestion, transformation and serving so failures can be replayed. Track source versions and indexing watermarks; retrieval should reveal when data is stale or incomplete.
lessons.whyItMatters: Index freshness must be observable and tied to source versions.
lessons.engineerDeepDive: Separate ingestion, transformation and serving so failures can be replayed. Track source versions and indexing watermarks; retrieval should reveal when data is stale or incomplete.

lessons.title: Tenant isolation and access filters
lessons.description: Design cache keys and authorization checks that include tenant context.
lessons.conceptOverview: Apply access constraints before returning evidence and enforce them consistently in search, caches and storage. Test cross-tenant queries even when identifiers or embeddings are similar.
lessons.whyItMatters: Isolation must cover cached results as well as retrieval.

lessons.title: Cache invalidation and correctness
lessons.description: Specify a version-aware key and invalidation event.
lessons.conceptOverview: A cache key should include inputs that affect the result, such as model, policy, permissions and data version. TTL limits age but does not solve immediate revocation or semantic incompatibility.
lessons.whyItMatters: Result identity includes relevant policy and data versions.

lessons.title: Consistency and index migration
lessons.description: Design a dual-index migration with validation and cutover checkpoints.
lessons.conceptOverview: Index rebuilds should support validation before traffic switches. Use versioned indexes and a controlled cutover, and plan rollback while preventing writes from being lost across versions.
lessons.whyItMatters: Incompatible embedding versions require explicit index separation.
